Package com.rpglab.game.interfaces

Interface CombatAction

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    AcidSpit, ClawSwipe, DarkSlash, DarkSpell, FireBreath, HealingPotion, PetrifyingGaze, PoisonousBite, PowerfulSpell, PreciseShot, Roar, RustySword, Swallow, Tackle, TailSwipe, TailWhip
    public interface CombatAction
    Represents an action that can be performed during combat. This interface defines the contract for all combat actions including attacks, spells, healing potions, and other battlefield abilities.

    Combat actions are executed between two combatants - a user who performs the action and a target who receives its effects. The action's implementation determines what happens when it is executed.

    • Method Detail

      • execute

        void execute​(Combatente user,
             Combatente target)
        Executes this combat action between the specified user and target. The specific behavior depends on the implementation of the action.

        Examples of execution effects include:

        • Dealing damage to the target
        • Healing the user or target
        • Applying status effects
        • Modifying combat statistics
        Parameters:
        user - The combatant performing this action
        target - The combatant who is the target of this action
